            rotation = {0, 180, 0},
            width = 500,
            height = 500,
            font_size = 200,
            color = {0,0,0,0},
            tooltip = "Rotate Clock\nLeft Click: Clockwise\nRight Click: Counterclockwise"
        })
    else
        self.setDecals({})
    end 
end

function rotate(clock,player_color,alt_click)
    local degrees = 60
    if alt_click then 
        degrees = -60 
    end

    if clock then
        ROT = clock.getRotation()
        ROT.y = ROT.y + degrees
        clock.setRotation(ROT)
    end
end

    self.createButton({
        label          = "New Round",
        click_function = "startRound",
        function_owner = self,
        position       = {0, 1, 0},
        rotation       = {0, 0, 0},
        width          = 1700,
        height         = 700,
        font_size      = 200,
        tooltip        = "Click to reset and start a new round",
        color          = BUTTON_COLOR,
        font_color     = BUTTON_TEXT_COLOR
    })
end

-- Force fixed cards to their positions (even if outside zones)
for guid, data in pairs(FIXED_CARDS) do
    local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if obj then
        obj.setPositionSmooth(data.pos, false, false)
        if data.rot then
            obj.setRotationSmooth(data.rot, false, false)
        end
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- === MAIN ROUND LOGIC ===
--------------------------------------------------
function startRound()
    local deckZone = getObjectFromGUID(deckZoneGUID)
    if not deckZone then return end

    -- Collect cards from zones
    for _, guid in ipairs(collectZoneGUIDs) do
        local zone = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if zone then
            for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
                if obj.tag == "Card" or obj.tag == "Deck" then
                    if IGNORE_NAMES[obj.getName()] then
                        -- ignore
                    elseif FIXED_CARDS[obj.getGUID()] then
                        local data = FIXED_CARDS[obj.getGUID()]
                        obj.setPositionSmooth(data.pos, false, false)
                        if data.rot then
                            obj.setRotationSmooth(data.rot, false, false)
                        end
                    else
                        obj.setPositionSmooth(collectPos, false, false)
                        obj.setRotationSmooth(collectRot, false, false)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Collect player hands (instant)
    for _, color in ipairs(VALID_COLORS) do
        if Player[color].seated then
            for _, obj in ipairs(Player[color].getHandObjects()) do
                if IGNORE_NAMES[obj.getName()] then
                    -- ignore
                elseif FIXED_CARDS[obj.getGUID()] then
                    local data = FIXED_CARDS[obj.getGUID()]
                    obj.setPosition(data.pos)
                    if data.rot then
                        obj.setRotation(data.rot)
                    end
                else
                    obj.setPosition(collectPos)
                    obj.setRotation(collectRot)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Delay to allow movements, then shuffle + deal
    Wait.time(function()
        local deck = findDeckInZone(deckZone)
        if not deck then
            broadcastToAll("No deck found in deck zone!", {1,0,0})
            return
        end
        if deck.shuffle then
            deck.shuffle()
        end
        dealCards(deck)
    end, 1.5)
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- === FIND DECK OR CARD IN ZONE ===
--------------------------------------------------
function findDeckInZone(zone)
    for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
        if obj.tag == "Deck" or obj.tag == "Card" then
            return obj
        end
    end
    return nil
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- === DEALING LOGIC ===
--------------------------------------------------
function dealCards(deck)
    local seated = {}
    local hand = {}

    for _, color in ipairs(VALID_COLORS) do
        if Player[color].seated then
            table.insert(seated, color)
        end
    end

    local numPlayers = #seated
    if numPlayers == 0 then return end

    local cardsEach = 0
    if numPlayers == 2 then
        cardsEach = 4
    elseif numPlayers == 3 then
        cardsEach = 4
    elseif numPlayers == 4 then
        cardsEach = 3
    end

    -- Deal to hands
    if cardsEach > 0 then
        for _, color in ipairs(seated) do
            --deck.deal(cardsEach, color)
            local spot = extraCardSpots[color]
            if spot then
                for i = 1, cardsEach do
                    deck.takeObject({
                        position = spot.pos[i],
                        rotation = spot.rot,
                        flip     = true,
                        smooth   = true
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Special 2-player extra cards
    if numPlayers == 2 then
        for _, color in ipairs(seated) do
            local spot = extraCardSpots[color]
            if spot then
                for i = 1, 2 do
                    deck.takeObject({
                        position = spot.pos[5],
                        rotation = spot.rot,
                        flip     = true,
                        smooth   = true
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- === CONFIG ===
local BUTTON_COLOR = {0.000, 0.075, 0.188}
local BUTTON_TEXT_COLOR = {0.894, 0.769, 0.153}

local zone_GUIDs = {"615d79", "145702", "29b0cf", "9f3524", "d1040a", "2594f5"}

-- === BUTTON CREATION ===
function onLoad()
    self.createButton({
        label          = "Reveal Cards",
        click_function = "startRound",
        function_owner = self,
        position       = {0, 1, 0},
        rotation       = {0, 0, 0},
        width          = 1700,
        tooltip        = "Click to reveal all the cards",
        height         = 700,
        font_size      = 200,
        color          = BUTTON_COLOR,
        font_color     = BUTTON_TEXT_COLOR
    })
end

-- === HELPERS ===
local function normalizeAngle(a)
    while a < 0 do a = a + 360 end
    while a >= 360 do a = a - 360 end
    return a
end

local function isFaceDown(obj)
    if type(obj.is_face_down) == "function" then
        local ok, res = pcall(obj.is_face_down, obj)
        if ok and res ~= nil then return res end
    end
    local rot = obj.getRotation()
    local x = normalizeAngle(rot.x)
    local z = normalizeAngle(rot.z)
    return (x > 90 and x < 270) or (z > 90 and z < 270)
end

local function isNumericName(name)
    if not name then return false end
    name = tostring(name):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    return name:match("^%d+$") ~= nil
end

-- === MAIN FUNCTION ===
function startRound()
    for _, guid in ipairs(zone_GUIDs) do
        local zone = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if zone then
            for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
                if (obj.tag == "Card" or obj.tag == "CardCustom")
                and isNumericName(obj.getName())
                and isFaceDown(obj) then
                    obj.flip()
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Zone GUID
zone_guid = '29b0cf' -- Change this to your zone GUID

function onLoad()
    targetZone = getObjectFromGUID(zone_guid)
    if not targetZone then
        print("Error: Zone with GUID " .. zone_guid .. " not found!")
        return
    end

    -- Create a button to show the total
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "none",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "",
        position       = {0, 1, 0},
        rotation       = {0, 0, 0},
        width          = 0,
        height         = 0,
        font_size      = 1200,
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1}, -- White text
    })

    calculateTotal()
end

function onObjectEnterZone(zone, object)
    if zone == targetZone then Wait.time(calculateTotal, 0.2) end
end

function onObjectLeaveZone(zone, object)
    if zone == targetZone then Wait.time(calculateTotal, 0.2) end
end

-- === Helpers ===
local function normalizeAngle(a)
    while a < 0 do a = a + 360 end
    while a >= 360 do a = a - 360 end
    return a
end

local function isFaceDown(obj)
    if type(obj.is_face_down) == "function" then
        local ok, res = pcall(obj.is_face_down, obj)
        if ok and res ~= nil then return res end
    end
    local rot = obj.getRotation()
    local x = normalizeAngle(rot.x)
    local z = normalizeAngle(rot.z)
    return (x > 90 and x < 270) or (z > 90 and z < 270)
end

local clockZone = getObjectFromGUID("ec7366")

function calculateTotal()
    if not targetZone then return end

    local total = 0
    local flagSubtract = 0
    local objects = targetZone.getObjects()
    if #objects == 0 then
        self.editButton({index = 0, label = ""})
        return
    end
    

    if clockZone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(clockZone.getObjects()) do
            if string.sub(obj.getName(), 1, 1) == "6" then
                flagSubtract = 1
            end
        end
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
        if obj.tag == "Card" or obj.tag == "CardCustom" then
            local val = tonumber(obj.getName())
            if not val or isFaceDown(obj) then
                -- Hide label if any card is face down or non-numeric
                self.editButton({index = 0, label = ""})
                return
            end
            if flagSubtract == 0 then
                total = total + val
            elseif flagSubtract == 1 then
                total = math.abs(total - val)
            end  
        end
    end

    -- Hide if total = 0
    if total == 0 then
        self.editButton({index = 0, label = ""})
    else
        self.editButton({index = 0, label = tostring(total)})
    end
end

-- Zone GUID
zone_guid = '145702' -- Change this to your zone GUID

function onLoad()
    targetZone = getObjectFromGUID(zone_guid)
    if not targetZone then
        print("Error: Zone with GUID " .. zone_guid .. " not found!")
        return
    end

    -- Create a button to show the total
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "none",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "",
        position       = {0, 1, 0},
        rotation       = {0, 0, 0},
        width          = 0,
        height         = 0,
        font_size      = 1200,
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1}, -- White text
    })

    calculateTotal()
end

function onObjectEnterZone(zone, object)
    if zone == targetZone then Wait.time(calculateTotal, 0.2) end
end

function onObjectLeaveZone(zone, object)
    if zone == targetZone then Wait.time(calculateTotal, 0.2) end
end

-- === Helpers ===
local function normalizeAngle(a)
    while a < 0 do a = a + 360 end
    while a >= 360 do a = a - 360 end
    return a
end

local function isFaceDown(obj)
    if type(obj.is_face_down) == "function" then
        local ok, res = pcall(obj.is_face_down, obj)
        if ok and res ~= nil then return res end
    end
    local rot = obj.getRotation()
    local x = normalizeAngle(rot.x)
    local z = normalizeAngle(rot.z)
    return (x > 90 and x < 270) or (z > 90 and z < 270)
end

local clockZone = getObjectFromGUID("ec7366")

function calculateTotal()
    if not targetZone then return end

    local total = 0
    local flagSubtract = 0
    local objects = targetZone.getObjects()
    if #objects == 0 then
        self.editButton({index = 0, label = ""})
        return
    end
    
    if clockZone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(clockZone.getObjects()) do
            if string.sub(obj.getName(), 1, 1) == "6" then
                flagSubtract = 1
            end
        end
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
        if obj.tag == "Card" or obj.tag == "CardCustom" then
            local val = tonumber(obj.getName())
            if not val or isFaceDown(obj) then
                -- Hide label if any card is face down or non-numeric
                self.editButton({index = 0, label = ""})
                return
            end
            if flagSubtract == 0 then
                total = total + val
            elseif flagSubtract == 1 then
                total = math.abs(total - val)
            end  
        end
    end

    -- Hide if total = 0
    if total == 0 then
        self.editButton({index = 0, label = ""})
    else
        self.editButton({index = 0, label = tostring(total)})
    end
end
